amount.description: Charged amount in minor units (msats for BTC).

details.description: Everything an API only integrator needs to collect this attempt; the hosted pay page is optional. lightning: bolt11. onchain: address, amount_sats, uri. stripe: session_id and checkout_url (Stripe Checkout, returns to the success_url and cancel_url you supplied). revolut: widget {provider, token, mode, email} to open Revolut's embedded card widget, and checkout_url for Revolut's hosted page. paypal: checkout_url. Fields are only ever added.

token.description: Public order token for the widget.

net_credited.description: Msats credited to the project balance, set when a platform managed attempt is paid. Never more than was received.

platform_fee.description: Platform fee in msats, set when a platform managed attempt is paid. Rounded up.

CreatePayment.description: Send amount, or line_items to have the server compute it. With line_items, amount and tax are optional and must equal the computed values when sent.

grace_days.description: Days a customer has to pay a period's invoice when the method cannot be charged automatically

saved_method_id.description: Omit to get a first payment (payment_id, pay_url) that saves the card and activates the subscription when it settles.

CreateWithdrawal.description: Send the Idempotency-Key header (required). With provider_id the payout is paid from that project LND wallet to destination (bolt11 invoice, lightning address, lnurl or on-chain address) and does not touch the custody balance. Without it the payout is paid from the custody balance under the payout limits and approval rules, and destination must be a bolt11 invoice (or send destination_id of a verified saved destination).

amount.description: Msats, a whole number of sats.

destination_id.description: Custody only: a verified saved destination.

provider_id.description: One of the project's own LND providers, from GET /methods.

DiscountInput.description: Exactly one of amount or percent.

percent.description: 0 to 100, at most 2 decimals. Rounded half up on the subtotal.

error.description: Message string. Stays a string throughout /v1. In /v2 this key becomes the object now found in error_detail and the string moves to a deprecated error_message for one release. Read error_detail.code in new code.

EventType.description: Webhook and /v1/events types. Endpoint filters accept these, a prefix wildcard such as withdrawal.*, or *. withdrawal.* events carry data.withdrawal instead of data.payment.

ImportSavedMethod.description: Registers a card that already exists at the provider. Idempotent on provider_id and external_id: repeating the call returns the same saved method. The external ids are never returned.

provider_id.description: One of your enabled card providers

discount.description: This line's share of the discount

tax_rate.description: Percent, 0 to 100, at most 2 decimals. Exclusive with tax_amount.

platform_managed.description: True when the method runs on a shared platform wallet and settles into the project balance minus the platform fee.

Payment.description: Payment view, also the webhook data.payment object.

amount.description: Total in minor units: subtotal minus discount plus tax

dispute_status.description: Latest dispute state, null when the payment was never disputed.

disputed.description: True while a chargeback or dispute is open. The status itself does not change.

receipt_url.description: Public HTML receipt, available once paid

subtotal.description: Sum of line amounts, null without line items

customer_receipts.description: When false the gateway sends no email to customers for this project (receipts, payment failed or refund notices). Project owners are still notified of operational events. Set in the console project settings. Defaults to true.

message.description: Fixed success text or a sanitized error. Never contains credentials.

ProviderType.description: method/provider_type pairs a project can configure in the console. Config fields per type are in the README.

amount.description: Minor units. Omit for the full remaining amount.

Withdrawal.description: Withdrawal view, also the webhook data.withdrawal object.

external_id.description: Payment hash or txid once paid.

bearerAuth.description: Project API key. Keys carry scopes: payments:write, payments:read, refunds:write, saved:write, withdrawals:read, withdrawals:write, admin.

info.description: Changes inside /v1 are additive. Breaking changes ship under a new version prefix. See docs/CHANGELOG.md.
